scope: Taiwan-first opportunity discovery; no build or paid-pilot recommendation

claim_audit.payment_evidence: Completed customer-review language and platform contract/payment description on https://www.pro360.com.tw/category/ec_third_partner; applies to broad e-commerce outsourcing category, not the exact fixed bundle.
claim_audit.buyer: Observed: Taiwan microbrands and e-commerce buyers appear in PRO360 requests, Tasker requests and 104 roles.
claim_audit.problem: Observed: recurring platform operations, listings, orders, customer service, inventory and returns are paid internal duties and outsourced requests.
claim_audit.externalizability: Observed: completed comparable outsourcing reviews plus recent Tasker buyer requests; exact narrow bundle remains Unknown.
claim_audit.recurrence: Observed/inferred: daily/weekly operations and campaign cycles recur; same-customer repeat for a fixed scope is Unknown.
claim_audit.standardization: Inferred: platform/task bundle, SLA, checklist and exception queue can be standardized; broad strategy/creative scope cannot be assumed.
claim_audit.leverage: Inferred: SOPs, batch operations, trained operators and selective automation may reduce founder-hours; not measured.

evidence_items.independence: Taiwan marketplace category with completed-review language
evidence_items.limitations: comparable broad category; exact fixed package not verified
posted requests and budgets are not proof of payment
internal hiring does not prove outsourcing

contradictions: full-service incumbents may already cover the need
quality and exceptions may make labor linear
narrow package may be too small
claim_audit.next_evidence_to_collect: Offer one platform/one task bundle via an existing marketplace and seek a concrete start commitment; compare scope and exceptions across two buyers.

claim_audit.recurrence: Observed/inferred: monthly close and tax handoff recur; second-month repeat is Unknown.
claim_audit.standardization: Inferred: channel mapping, exception taxonomy, QA and handoff packet can be reused.
claim_audit.leverage: Inferred: rules/templates, standardized intake, operator QA and selective automation.

contradictions: licensed accounting firms/ERP may already solve the workflow
claim_audit.next_evidence_to_collect: Obtain one redacted month and an accepted quote or scheduled continuation; compare two sellers' exception schemas.

strongest_evidence: Completed-review/payment workflow is visible for Taiwan e-commerce outsourcing, accounting, crawler and data-entry categories.
Recent Tasker buyer requests expose recurring e-commerce operations and month-close outsourcing intent.
104 listings independently show the labor burden in Taiwan employers.
weakest_claims: Exact fixed-scope package payment for either e-commerce candidate.
Cross-customer standardization for generic data conversion or monitoring.
contradictions: Broad incumbents may already satisfy buyers.
Marketplace reviews are selected and do not measure prevalence.
Recurring workflows can remain labor-linear despite recurring demand.
unsupported_precision: No TAM, CAC, LTV, retention, conversion or exact savings estimate is asserted.
critical_unknowns: Exact wedge payment vs comparable category payment
next_evidence_to_collect: Seek concrete commitment for the two e-commerce scopes through existing marketplaces, preserving the distinction between category payment and exact-wedge payment.
